dict.string: Anticipy records the other people in a meeting from your Mac's system audio when you start a recording. Audio stays on this Mac; only the on-device transcript is sent to Anticipy.
Anticipy records your side of a meeting when you start a recording. Audio stays on this Mac; only the on-device transcript is sent to Anticipy.
Anticipy turns both sides of your meeting into text on this Mac so it can remember what was said and act on it.
